jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Shoulder Sleeper makes recovery pillows and products for people healing from shoulder surgery. Our pillow is designed to be used alongside the sling from a patient's surgeon. We've helped more than 30,000 patients and work with more than 300 medical professionals. We're a small team in Orange County, so your work will be seen and felt every day.

Our customers are usually in pain, short on sleep, and a little overwhelmed. How we treat them matters as much as the product.

THE ROLE

You'll be the human voice of Shoulder Sleeper. You'll own our customer conversations on every channel, run our social media, and help build the brand. Your job is to make every customer feel looked after, whether that's a patient two days out of surgery or a clinic getting ready for its next patients. Most of all, you'll obsess over making every customer's experience better.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer experience

* Manage our phone line, support email, text messages, and website chat during office hours.

* Answer every customer kindly, clearly, and quickly.

* Help customers with orders, shipping, returns, and how to use their pillow.

* Follow up after purchase so customers feel supported through recovery.

* Go the extra mile: find unhappy customers online, reach out personally, and (with manager approval) send a replacement pillow or a handwritten note.

* Look at every step of the customer journey and find ways to make it easier.

* Track common questions and complaints, and turn them into fixes, FAQs, or new content.

* Log any customer reaction or side effect report and send it to leadership the same day.

* Keep clear notes, and share what customers are telling us with the team every week.

Community and social

* Run our Facebook group and keep it active, helpful, and positive.

* Reply to every comment on our ads and social posts.

* Find customers in the comments and turn them into conversations, reviews, and stories (with their permission).

* Plan, create, and schedule content across our social channels.

* Write captions, emails, and short videos that are helpful, kind, and on brand.

* Join the conversation in online recovery communities, like shoulder surgery support groups and patient forums.

* Reach out to medical and physical therapy pages, healthcare creators, and recovery accounts to get Shoulder Sleeper in front of their followers.

* Connect with larger practices and surgery centers that have an active social presence for features or collaborations.

* Track outreach and results so we know what's working.

* Send new content through our team's review process before it goes live.

Creative and marketing materials

* Create graphics in Canva, using AI tools to work faster.

* Order trifolds and other printed marketing materials for our clinics and for us, through our team's approval process.

* Help clinics and surgeon offices choose products and get the marketing materials they need.

GROWTH PATH

As you grow, you can take over our email marketing in Klaviyo, including campaigns, flows, and performance. Raises are tied to taking on that ownership.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have

* A warm, patient communicator who likes helping people. Customer support or other customer-facing experience is a plus.

* Clear, warm writing. You can explain things simply to someone who is tired and hurting.

* Social media savvy, especially Facebook groups and ad comments, with experience creating content for a brand.

* Comfortable with Canva and everyday AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, AI image tools).

* A real drive to make customers' lives easier, and the habit of noticing what could be better.

* Organized and self-directed across several channels at once, with good follow-through on details.

* Able to work in person at our Irvine warehouse.

Nice to have

* Experience with Klaviyo or Shopify.

* Healthcare, physical therapy, or patient-facing experience.

* Experience at a small e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brand.

* Short-form video skills, including filming and editing on a phone.

* Experience with creator, influencer, or community outreach, especially in healthcare.

* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

PAY AND SCHEDULE

* Pay: $22 to $25 per hour, with raises as you take on more ownership.

* Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday during office hours. No weekends.

* Location: In person at our Irvine warehouse.

* Start date: As soon as possible.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here with your resume and 2 or 3 examples of social content you've made (links are fine). In a few sentences, tell us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a happy one.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.

Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Global Relay, you will be the primary point of contact and a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers across our SMB and Mid-Market segment. * Act as the primary point of contact for your customer portfolio, building trusted relationships across both operational and executive stakeholders
* Own renewal strategy and drive gross revenue retention, upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year commitments
* Identify and execute on expansion opportunities through data analysis, usage trends, and business objectives
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customer issues, coordinating with Support, Product, and Client Services to resolve challenges

* Understand customer objectives, align Global Relay solutions, and proactively deliver insights, benchmarking, and best practices
* Create customer champions and advocate for customer needs internally

* Participate in strategic customer programs, feedback sessions, training initiatives, and industry events
* Enhance customers' target operating models and optimize to improve satisfaction and usage

**About you:**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Client Services — preferably in SaaS, financial services, compliance, or a regulated industry
* Proven ability to manage a portfolio of mid-sized accounts with varying degrees of complexity
* Strategic thinker with the ability to communicate clearly and influence across all levels, including executives

* Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM platform
* Resourceful, proactive, and collaborative with a strong customer-first mindset

* Experience working with mid-market customers in a compliance-driven SaaS environment
* Prior involvement in creating or scaling customer success playbooks or enablement initiatives
* Experience with customer lifecycle programs, customer journey mapping, or voice-of-customer programs

At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

The Armenian General Benevolent Union was established in 1906 and is the world’s largest non-profit organization devoted to preserving and promoting the Armenian identity and heritage through educational, cultural, and humanitarian programs. AGBU currently has a presence in over 40 countries, annually touching the lives of some 500,000 Armenians worldwide.

**About Camp Nubar**

Founded in 1963, Camp Nubar is a six-week sleep-away summer camp located on its 365-acre home in the Catskill Mountains region of New York State. Each summer over 300 campers from all over the world (Canada, Europe, Eurasia, all across America) call Camp Nubar their home away from home. Camp Nubar has state-of-the-art facilities, a varied program, and is proud to offer a rich cultural experience in an environment that rivals the best privately owned summer camps in America. The goals of Camp Nubar are determined by a Committee of approximately 12 volunteer members, all alumni of the camp themselves.

The Program Coordinator reports to the Director of Diaspora Youth Programs and works closely with the Camp Nubar Committee Chair, Camp Director, and Camp Nubar Committee. The position is based out of AGBU’s global headquarters in New York City and may require occasional weekend and evening hours.

* Manage the Camp Nubar enrollment platform and participant records, including applications, forms, session placement, payments, scholarships/financial assistance documentation, required medical and administrative forms, and enrollment status
* Ensuring compliance with the New York State Health Department and American Camp Association requirements
* Communicate with the Camp Director and camp leadership before and during the summer regarding administrative and program needs, including occasional camp visits

* Prepare and distribute pre-camp information, reminders, deadlines, policies, packing information, transportation details, and other family communications

**Fundraising:**

* Assist fundraising committees to create and implement direct mail and email fundraising campaigns
* Assist in event management for a wide range of fundraising events, from large-scale (400-guest) galas to smaller-scale events

**Marketing and Communications:**

* Coordinate the annual communications calendar and promotional needs for camper and counselor recruitment with AGBU Communications and the Camp Nubar Committee

jobs.description:
Social Media Marketing Coordinator

**Babyface Brows | Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part-Time | 15–25 hours/week | $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Please apply through this online posting only. We ask that applicants do not call or come into the studio regarding this opportunity. Applications submitted by phone or in person will not be considered.** If we see a potential fit, our team will reach out directly.

About the Studio

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio located in Park Slope, Brooklyn, steps from Barclays Center. Our focus is simple: expert brows, beautiful lashes, and an experience that keeps clients coming back.

We're looking for someone creative and driven to help tell our brand's story, create engaging social content, and strengthen our online presence.

The Opportunity

In this position, you'll work alongside management to develop and produce content for Babyface across Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.

You'll be involved in the creative process from coming up with ideas and planning shoots to filming, editing, and publishing. As you gain experience with the brand, you'll have the opportunity to take on more independence and contribute to additional areas of marketing.

Content Experience Is Required

**You must have experience creating and publishing content.** This doesn't have to come from a formal job. Personal social media, freelance projects, school assignments, or content you've created for a business are all relevant. What matters most is being able to show us what you've made and how you approach content creation.

Responsibilities

**Social Media & Content Production**

You'll help develop a variety of content for our social channels, such as:

* Before-and-after photos and transformations
* Informative graphics and educational carousels
* Reels, TikToks, skits, trends, and original video concepts
* Engaging stories and community-focused posts
* Behind-the-scenes content featuring our studio and team
* Other creative ideas that align with the Babyface brand

Other responsibilities include:

* Finding inspiration, researching trends, and pitching content ideas
* Organizing filming sessions with clients and artists
* Capturing services, results, and everyday studio activity
* Directing people during filming and helping them feel at ease
* Editing photos and videos with CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms
* Writing, preparing, and scheduling social media posts
* Helping maintain a steady flow of fresh, on-brand content

What You'll Work Toward

You'll begin by collaborating with management on content planning and production, with an emphasis on posting more consistently and improving the quality and creativity of what we share.

As you become familiar with our brand and audience, we want you to gradually own more of the process, including the content calendar, shoot planning, production, publishing, and performance review.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone who can take an idea and carry it through to a finished piece of content with increasing independence.

Room to Expand Into Marketing

This opportunity isn't limited to creating social media posts. As the business grows, there's potential to get involved in a wider range of marketing activities, including:

* Email marketing and promotional campaigns
* Local business partnerships and community outreach
* Influencer relationships and brand collaborations
* Paid advertising through Meta and Google
* Marketing initiatives and promotional materials
* Customer research, surveys, audience segmentation, and performance analysis
* Developing and eventually helping manage a broader marketing team

The position can evolve alongside the business and the skills you bring to it.

What Makes Someone a Good Fit

We're not looking for a particular number of years on a résumé. We value creativity, initiative, organization, and the ability to turn ideas into action.

Ideally, you are someone who:

* Enjoys brainstorming and developing original ideas
* Has experience producing short-form video content
* Is comfortable filming and directing people
* Can stay organized and keep projects moving
* Takes initiative and can work without constant direction
* Knows their way around CapCut, Canva, or similar tools
* Has an interest in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or social media
* Enjoys learning, experimenting, and trying new approaches

*You know that feeling when you see a trend and immediately think of how a brand could make it its own? That's the kind of creative thinking we're looking for.*

Compensation & Benefits

**$20–$24/hour, based on experience and portfolio**

* Flexible scheduling
* Employee discount
* Referral program
* Opportunity for additional hours and increased responsibility as the business develops

Application Tips

We strongly encourage you to include a portfolio or a link to content you've created. This could be an Instagram page, TikTok account, individual video, campaign, or personal project.

You don't need a polished professional portfolio. We simply want to see your creativity, style, and ability to execute an idea.

Pay: $20.00 - $24.00 per hour

Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the ongoing operations, performance, and resident experience of an established multifamily or Active Adult community. This role provides leadership and direction to on-site team members while ensuring operational efficiency, financial performance, and a high standard of customer service.  
With a strong focus on resident satisfaction, team development, and community culture, the Community Manager maintains full compliance with Greystar policies and applicable federal, state, and local laws—including Fair Housing, ADA, and FCRA. This position plays a pivotal role in sustaining long-term community success through proactive management, strategic planning, and consistent delivery of an exceptional living environment tailored to the needs of current and future residents.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Responds promptly to resident concerns, complaints, questions, and requests, and takes appropriate action to resolve and address issues. Handles escalated resident disputes with empathy and problem-solving.
* Completes various required accounting, financial, administrative, operational, and other reports, and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Serves as the liaison with ownership, investors, and regional/asset management teams. Leads ownership/partner site visits, providing performance updates, market insights, and suggestions to improve overall performance and financial success of the property. Provides recommendations for long-term asset preservation, revenue growth, and expense control strategies.
* Oversees hiring, onboarding, and training, and manages performance and professional development of team members in accordance with Company policies, values, and business practices. Ensures team members are current on all required trainings and certifications, and any/all performance issues are appropriately and promptly addressed.
* Oversees the lease enforcement process by making periodic apartment inspections, following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and imposing and collecting late fees and other charges as allowable and stated in the terms of the lease. Enforces community rules and lease policies to maintain a safe and orderly environment. Coordinates with legal counsel for evictions, lease disputes, and compliance matters.
* Conducts interactive Daily Huddles, regular one-on-one coaching/check-ins, and annual reviews. Meets regularly with team members to understand and assist in completion of their required responsibilities and annual goal setting. Keeps them informed of resident situations as necessary. Shares team and community goals and engages them to understand their role in helping the team in accomplishing them.
* Supervises sales activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals. Monitors leasing team performance and metrics (closing ratios, lead conversion, traffic sources, and lead management). Conduct community tours as needed and ensure model and vacant units are in good standing and tour ready.

* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
* Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle.
* Located within commuting distance of Chicago's North Side or North Shore suburbs.

Social Media Marketing Coordinator

**Babyface Brows | Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part-Time | 15–25 hours/week | $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Please apply through this online posting only. We ask that applicants do not call or come into the studio regarding this opportunity. Applications submitted by phone or in person will not be considered.** If we see a potential fit, our team will reach out directly.

About the Studio

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio located in Park Slope, Brooklyn, steps from Barclays Center. Our focus is simple: expert brows, beautiful lashes, and an experience that keeps clients coming back.

We're looking for someone creative and driven to help tell our brand's story, create engaging social content, and strengthen our online presence.

The Opportunity

In this position, you'll work alongside management to develop and produce content for Babyface across Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.

You'll be involved in the creative process from coming up with ideas and planning shoots to filming, editing, and publishing. As you gain experience with the brand, you'll have the opportunity to take on more independence and contribute to additional areas of marketing.

Content Experience Is Required

**You must have experience creating and publishing content.** This doesn't have to come from a formal job. Personal social media, freelance projects, school assignments, or content you've created for a business are all relevant. What matters most is being able to show us what you've made and how you approach content creation.

Responsibilities

**Social Media & Content Production**

You'll help develop a variety of content for our social channels, such as:

* Before-and-after photos and transformations
* Informative graphics and educational carousels
* Reels, TikToks, skits, trends, and original video concepts
* Engaging stories and community-focused posts
* Behind-the-scenes content featuring our studio and team
* Other creative ideas that align with the Babyface brand

Other responsibilities include:

* Finding inspiration, researching trends, and pitching content ideas
* Organizing filming sessions with clients and artists
* Capturing services, results, and everyday studio activity
* Directing people during filming and helping them feel at ease
* Editing photos and videos with CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms
* Writing, preparing, and scheduling social media posts
* Helping maintain a steady flow of fresh, on-brand content

What You'll Work Toward

You'll begin by collaborating with management on content planning and production, with an emphasis on posting more consistently and improving the quality and creativity of what we share.

As you become familiar with our brand and audience, we want you to gradually own more of the process, including the content calendar, shoot planning, production, publishing, and performance review.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone who can take an idea and carry it through to a finished piece of content with increasing independence.

Room to Expand Into Marketing

This opportunity isn't limited to creating social media posts. As the business grows, there's potential to get involved in a wider range of marketing activities, including:

* Email marketing and promotional campaigns
* Local business partnerships and community outreach
* Influencer relationships and brand collaborations
* Paid advertising through Meta and Google
* Marketing initiatives and promotional materials
* Customer research, surveys, audience segmentation, and performance analysis
* Developing and eventually helping manage a broader marketing team

The position can evolve alongside the business and the skills you bring to it.

What Makes Someone a Good Fit

We're not looking for a particular number of years on a résumé. We value creativity, initiative, organization, and the ability to turn ideas into action.

Ideally, you are someone who:

* Enjoys brainstorming and developing original ideas
* Has experience producing short-form video content
* Is comfortable filming and directing people
* Can stay organized and keep projects moving
* Takes initiative and can work without constant direction
* Knows their way around CapCut, Canva, or similar tools
* Has an interest in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or social media
* Enjoys learning, experimenting, and trying new approaches

*You know that feeling when you see a trend and immediately think of how a brand could make it its own? That's the kind of creative thinking we're looking for.*

Compensation & Benefits

**$20–$24/hour, based on experience and portfolio**

* Flexible scheduling
* Employee discount
* Referral program
* Opportunity for additional hours and increased responsibility as the business develops

Application Tips

We strongly encourage you to include a portfolio or a link to content you've created. This could be an Instagram page, TikTok account, individual video, campaign, or personal project.

You don't need a polished professional portfolio. We simply want to see your creativity, style, and ability to execute an idea.
